meta.name: cost-tracker
meta.description: Track session costs, set budget alerts, and optimize token spend. Use to check costs mid-session or set spending limits.

copy.tagline: 追踪会话费用并设置预算提醒
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在AI会话中实时监控和限制token花费
copy.tagline_en: Track session costs and set budget alerts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to monitor and limit token spending in AI sessions

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会帮你跟踪当前会话的花费，显示 token 用量和缓存命中率，并给出优化建议。
howto.when: 当你询问会话成本、设置预算提醒或优化 token 消耗时触发。

say.text: 检查当前会话花费了多少。
say.note: Claude 会显示会话成本、token 用量等。

say.text: 帮我设置一个 3 美元的预算提醒。
say.note: Claude 会在达到预算阈值时提醒你。

say.text: 优化一下 token 使用。
say.note: Claude 会给出具体的优化建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you track session costs, display token usage and cache hit rate, and provide optimization tips.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about session costs, set budget alerts, or optimize token spend.

say_en.text: Check how much the current session has cost.
say_en.note: Claude will show session cost, token usage, etc.
Claude will remind you when the budget threshold is reached.
Claude will give specific optimization suggestions.
